related.title: Web Workers：移轉ArrayBuffer與所有權
related.titleEn: Web Workers: transferable ArrayBuffers and ownership
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付retainer-notes.csv、重複生命週期測試與估算/實測差異表。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver retainer-notes.csv, repeated-lifecycle tests and estimated-versus-measured differences.
related.difference: 建立buffer後postMessage到worker，分別有無transfer list，記錄送端byteLength與接端checksum。
related.differenceEn: Post a buffer to a worker with and without a transfer list; record sender byteLength and receiver checksum.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
GC回收不可達物件，不會猜測仍被參照的快取何時不再需要；heap大小與活物件大小不同。
教學基準：2500*200 = 500000 estimated_B；對照：500*200 = 100000 estimated_B。

移轉ArrayBuffer讓送端失去原緩衝使用權；structured clone複製語意與transfer所有權語意不同。
教學基準：1024*1024*4 = 4194304 B；對照：2*1024*1024*4 = 8388608 B。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
GC reclaims unreachable objects, not cached objects that remain referenced; heap capacity differs from live-object size.
Teaching baseline: 2500*200 = 500000 estimated_B; comparison: 500*200 = 100000 estimated_B.

Transferring an ArrayBuffer removes sender access to its storage; structured-clone copying and transfer ownership are distinct semantics.
Teaching baseline: 1024*1024*4 = 4194304 B; comparison: 2*1024*1024*4 = 8388608 B.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Bazel：密封輸入與遠端快取鍵
related.titleEn: Bazel: hermetic inputs and remote-cache keys
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付retainer-notes.csv、重複生命週期測試與估算/實測差異表。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver retainer-notes.csv, repeated-lifecycle tests and estimated-versus-measured differences.
related.difference: 列出action key應涵蓋的來源、命令、工具鏈與指定環境；在兩乾淨目錄重建比較digest。
related.differenceEn: List source, command, toolchain and declared environment inputs to each key; rebuild in two clean directories and compare digests.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
GC回收不可達物件，不會猜測仍被參照的快取何時不再需要；heap大小與活物件大小不同。
教學基準：2500*200 = 500000 estimated_B；對照：500*200 = 100000 estimated_B。

可重現action需宣告輸入與工具鏈；未宣告的環境變數或主機檔案可能使同key產生不同結果。
教學基準：20*2+5 = 45 serial_s；對照：10*2+5 = 25 serial_s。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
GC reclaims unreachable objects, not cached objects that remain referenced; heap capacity differs from live-object size.
Teaching baseline: 2500*200 = 500000 estimated_B; comparison: 500*200 = 100000 estimated_B.

Reproducible actions require declared inputs and toolchains; undeclared environment or host files can make identical keys yield different outputs.
Teaching baseline: 20*2+5 = 45 serial_s; comparison: 10*2+5 = 25 serial_s.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
